title: Green Beans with Toasted Almonds & Lemon
description: Blanched green beans sautéed with garlic and finished with toasted almonds, lemon zest, and fresh parsley.

instructions.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add {0} green beans and cook 3–4 minutes until bright green and crisp-tender. Drain and immediately rinse under cold water or transfer to an ice bath. Drain thoroughly.
Toast {1} almonds in a large dry skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently, 2–4 minutes until fragrant and lightly golden. Transfer to a plate.
Add {2} olive oil to the skillet. Add {3} garlic and cook about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the green beans and sauté 2–3 minutes until warmed through.
Remove from heat. Add the zest of {4} lemon, {5} lemon juice, {6} salt, {7} black pepper, and the toasted almonds. Toss to combine.
Sprinkle with {8} parsley and taste for seasoning before serving.

notes: Make-ahead friendly: blanch the beans several hours ahead and refrigerate. Finish in the skillet just before dinner. Pairs especially well with fish and seafood.
